comparison.objective: Remove a fuel can from a truck, fill it on the ground, then replace it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Can/nozzle transport and safety-rule sequencing versus precision tool engagement, fine adjustment, locking and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Body latches zero if fuel flows while the can is not grounded and clear of the truck; no complete spec version is present. Candidate latches failure on energized adjustment, hard-stop impact or unsafe dynamics.
comparison.reason: Shared safety sequencing does not make fuel handling and damper commissioning the same tested ability.
